Operational criterion: No full-race cluster exceeds the highlight category's null threshold.
Exactly one full-race cluster exceeds the threshold and does not satisfy the merge criterion.
Two or more full-race clusters exceed the threshold.
Interpretation: One highlight category corresponds to several full-race clusters.

Operational criterion: Exactly one full-race cluster exceeds the category threshold, and that cluster is also a supported counterpart of at least one other highlight category under the stricter merge threshold.
Interpretation: Several highlight categories converge on one full-race cluster.
